record.industry_experience: Between 2011 and 2013 Edit Horváth worked as a financial analyst at a regional consulting firm in Subotica, where she designed workforce-cost models for manufacturing clients undergoing restructuring. This experience shapes her preference for research questions that are directly actionable by firm management.
record.notes: Horváth is currently managing two active projects simultaneously and may have limited capacity for new large-scale commitments before mid-2025. She is particularly interested in partnering with NTP Novi Sad tenant companies that collect regular employee survey data and are willing to share anonymised financial records for longitudinal analysis. She has no formal econometrics laboratory but has institutional licences for Stata and R.
